name: Webeyez Analytics – Session Recording, Heatmaps & Conversion Monitoring
author: Webeyez

sections.description:
See how real users experience your site, find hidden errors, and stop losing sales.
Webeyez Analytics gives WordPress & WooCommerce site owners a complete monitoring toolkit: from session recordings and heatmaps to error tracking and AI-powered KPI insights.

Unlike traditional analytics, Webeyez connects real-user monitoring with business results (orders, conversions, forms, funnels). You’ll know exactly why conversions drop — slow pages, broken buttons, network errors, or checkout issues.

🔥 Key Benefits

  • Automatic setup: Install & activate — your Webeyez account is created instantly and credentials are sent to your WordPress admin email.
  • Free forever: Every installation starts with a free account. Upgrade anytime for higher volume or advanced features.
  • All-in-one toolkit: No need for multiple plugins — recordings, heatmaps, error tracking, and alerts in one place.

🚀 Features

  • Session Recording – Watch real users navigate your site, click by click.
  • Heatmaps & Clickmaps – See where users engage (and where they don’t).
  • Funnel Tracking – Analyze conversions across checkout, forms, and goals.
  • Events Tracking – Measure add-to-cart, form submissions, clicks, and more.
  • Error Tracking – Capture JavaScript errors, failed network calls, and broken CTAs.
  • Alerting System
    • Real-time anomaly alerts (drops in sales, errors, conversions).
    • Custom thresholds (e.g., “alert me if checkout conversion falls 30%”).
  • KPI Monitoring – Track goals, conversions, uptime, and page speed over time.
  • Opportunities Dashboard (AI-powered) – Automatically highlights only the most important issues so you can focus on what impacts your business most.
  • Engage & Fix – Quickly drill into problem sessions, segment by device, browser, or funnel stage, and take action.

🎯 Perfect For

  • WooCommerce store owners who want to prevent lost sales.
  • Marketers who want easy heatmaps & conversion funnels.
  • Developers who need to monitor errors, uptime, and performance.
  • Anyone who wants one plugin to replace multiple analytics & monitoring tools.

Account & Upgrades

  • Every site gets a free Webeyez account (auto-created on activation).
  • The free plan includes session recordings, heatmaps, funnel tracking, alerts, and more.
  • Upgrades are available if you need more monthly sessions or advanced enterprise features — but not required to start.

Support

Need help? Contact support@webeyez.com or visit www.webeyez.com.
sections.installation:
1. Install through the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate through Plugins → Installed Plugins.
  3. Webeyez automatically creates an account and sends login details to your WordPress admin email.

screenshots.caption: Events Dashboard – Track key actions such as add-to-cart, checkout login, shipping, search, and order placements.
Event Failure Details – Drill into failed actions with error messages, impacted revenue, devices, and session traces.
Session Recording – Replay user journeys click-by-click to uncover hidden issues and improve UX.
Session Analytics – Segment sessions by device, browser, country, traffic source, and conversion performance.
Heatmaps & Clickmaps – See clicks, dead clicks, rage clicks, and user interaction hotspots across your site.
Opportunities Dashboard (AI-powered) – Automatically prioritize the most revenue-impacting issues for quick wins.
Technology Overview – Track load times, failed calls, JavaScript errors, and performance metrics by page and browser.
JavaScript Error Tracking – Detect and analyze JS errors with stack traces, traffic segmentation, and error trends over time.
Failed Network Calls – Monitor failed API calls, error codes, impacted sessions, and devices to prevent broken functionality.
Alerts Management – Configure uptime and threshold alerts to get notified instantly about traffic drops or site downtime.
